code='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    center = round(sum(r for r, c in points) / len(points))
    markers = [c for r, c in points if r == center]
    if len(markers) == 1:
        start, end = 2, m - 3
    elif len(markers) == 2:
        start, end = max(0, min(markers) - 1), max(markers)
    else:
        start, end = 0, m - 1
    vertical = [c for c in range(m) if grid[0][c] == 0]
    out = [[0 if c in vertical else 7 for c in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
    out[center - 1] = [0] * m
    out[center + 1] = [0] * m
    out[center] = [5 if start <= c <= end else 7 for c in range(m)]
    return out
